PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Protector Fiberglass Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box with Auto Pressure Control, 2 Ports, N. America, 208-230V
PRODUCT_NAME: Protector Fiberglass Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box with Auto Pressure Control, 2 Ports, N. America, 208-230V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes provide a leak-tight environment to perform work with contamination-sensitive materials under vacuum or in an inert environment. Fiberglass-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels a low as 0.4 ppm & moisture levels as low as 2 ppm. Stainless steel-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels as low as 0.2 ppm & moisture levels as low as 1 ppm.
All Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) & 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).
Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Oxygen permeation <0.3 ppm/min (fiberglass-lined models) & <0.15 ppm/min (stainless steel-lined models) per ISO 10648-2
• Four manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control
• Factory-installed, rear-mounted, low profile stainless steel pressure relief bubbler at +/-6 inches of water gauge
• Two rear-mounted inlet & oulet compression fittings for easy connection to optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier or other accessory drying train
• Large viewing area, 36 in. wide x 27.6 in. high x .38 in. thick, laminated safety glass
• Space-saving inner & outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, counterbalanced & equipped with quick-latches.
• Interior right-hand side wall-mounted electrical duplex receptacle with 10 amp maximum (100/115V) or 10 amp maximum (230V) circuit load.
• Interior side wall-mounted pass through plug for on-site installation of an optional accessory
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light, blower & electrical duplex.
• Two 8 in. ID, epoxy-coated aluminum double-grooved glove ports mounted with neoprene gaskets
• Two fluorescent lights
• Dry-powder epoxy-coated, 18 & 20 gauge steel exterior panels

Options-All Models
• Chemical resistant, one-piece molded fiberglass liner or type 304 stainless steel liner
• International electrical configuration

Options-Basic Models
• Main chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from -5 to +5 inches of water gauge
• Transfer chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from 0 to 29.5 inches of mercury

Options-Fiberglass-Lined Models
• Clear acrylic inner and outer transfer chamber doors

Options-Stainless Steel-Lined Models
• Type 304 stainless steel inner and outer transfer chamber doors and front panel

Options-Auto Pressure Control Models
• Automatic Pressure Controller controls main chamber pressure, main chamber evacuation & filling cycles, & transfer chamber evacuation & filling cycles
• Mutable, audible alarm that sounds when pressure/vacuum level is outside set limits
• LCD display of main chamber and transfer chamber pressure in inches of water, inches of mercury and mBar
• Three-position foot pedal
• Input/output port for optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Required Accessories
• Adjustable height base stands
• Vacuum source
• Inert gas for filling

Optional Accessories
• AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier
